desk-review's report pane is now a plain list, and pressing an item opens its file in the Changes tab even after the change is committed.

- desk-review: each item is one line (status, folder, file name, line) with its reason below, grouped by a bar in its status colour. The narrow pane no longer unfolds code; press the item instead
- Pressing an item brings desk-look's Changes tab to the front. Before, it opened behind the report tab
- desk-look: a file desk-review asks for that has no uncommitted change is looked up in the branch's changes, then in the last commit that changed it, which unfolds in the commits view. Before, it only said the file had no uncommitted changes
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.73.2 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
